name: portfolio
title: Developer portfolio
description: A developer's portfolio made only with mangacn: a top bar whose section buttons scroll in place, an opening spread of two Panels with a slanted gutter (focus SpeedLines behind the portrait you pass (toned by TonedImage, or shown as it is when inked), a SpeechBubble, Sfx lettering and a band of motion lines), projects as a manga page of Cards (wide, two, wide) with the thumbnails you pass, Badge tags, a CodeBlock install snippet and links that do not navigate, skills as a CharacterCard with stat bars, a career as a vertical Stepper, and a contact form (Field, Input, Textarea, Button) that validates on submit, shakes its errors, shows a loading button and then a brush-check success panel. No network. One column on phones; container queries widen it. Works in light, dark, any accent and in manga reading order.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/portfolio". The page follows the document scroll; replace the name, projects, stats and career in the constants at the top of the file. The contact form only validates and shows a success panel: wire `submit` to your own endpoint. The block ships no image: pass the portrait and the project thumbnails in art.

meta.tagline: Intro panels, projects on a manga page, skills as a character sheet, a contact form.
